title: Kenyan Chicken Skewers
description: Succulent chicken skewers marinated in a blend of Kenyan spices, grilled to perfection. A delicious and easy-to-make dish perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: crushed floral spices
ingredients.notes: Use any combination of fennel, coriander, and cumin

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: Thread chicken, kenyan spice blend, and crushed floral spices onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with crispy fried onions and serve hot.
